description: This Java class configures OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation for a Spring Boot application. It dynamically constructs the server URL based on forwarded headers, enabling correct API URL generation in proxy or preview environments. It also sets API metadata such as title, description, contact info, and license.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up OpenAPI/Swagger documentation with dynamic server URL resolution based on request headers.

methods.name: customOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenAPI object with API metadata and dynamically resolved server URL if available.

methods.name: resolveServerUrl
methods.description: Attempts to construct the server URL from X-Forwarded-Proto, X-Forwarded-Host, and X-Forwarded-Port headers to support proxy and preview environments.
